title: Ingest refund claims from the Online Refunds Application contract into cases
scope: Make an RSL source, not the Vati claim form, start a case: read rsl.online_refunds.claim through the TAX-111 adapter (fixture), create the Vati Submission and Vati Refund Claim with origin rsl_online_refunds keyed on claim_id, and let the existing assurance, bridge and pipeline hooks run unchanged

acceptance.text: An ingest step reads Online Refunds claims for a tenant through the TAX-111 adapter and creates one Vati Submission and Vati Refund Claim per claim_id with origin rsl_online_refunds and the RSL claim reference; repeated reads replay, conflicting replays are refused
bridge should_register accepts the rsl_online_refunds origin so assurance.requested, case.registered and evidence linking run exactly as for a sent claim; the Jube mirror origin is still refused
Claim lines come from the contract; uploaded documents RSL already holds are stored as references with hashes, not copied; an unavailable source is reported as unavailable, never as no claims
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Bench test: a fixture Online Refunds claim produces one case with assurance findings and a lane; replay creates nothing twice

evidence.text: backend/vati_tax/vati_tax/rsl_intake: ingest_online_refunds(tenant) reads online_refunds.claim per Vati Taxpayer (TIN) through the site's TAX-111 source (factories.rsl_sources; recorded fixture) and, as the pipeline service identity, records one Vati Submission (source rsl_online_refunds; set-once source_ref = RSL claim_id, source_contract, source_record_sha256, source_refs) and one Vati Refund Claim per claim, keyed by the scoped idempotency key rsl:online-refunds:<claim_id>, then sends it. Replay and conflict: bench test_a_second_read_replays_and_a_changed_record_conflicts (second read: all replayed, nothing changed; a changed record under the same claim ID: conflict, submission and case unchanged). Pure rules: rsl_intake/test_rules.py. Entry point vati_tax.rsl_intake.api.ingest_online_refunds is operator-only (an auditor is refused in the bench test).

bridge.rules.submission_origin maps a non-mirror change of an rsl_online_refunds submission to origin rsl_online_refunds, and should_register now accepts exactly the taxpayer and rsl_online_refunds origins (mirror and unknown origins refused; bridge/test_rules.py). The assurance, bridge and pipeline hooks use it. Bench test_rsl_claims_become_sent_cases_and_the_checks_run_unchanged: every ingested claim is submitted with a case_id and events [assurance.requested, case.registered]; after draining, each case's assurance run is completed with claim_ref = the RSL claim ID and one lane proposal for it, no decision. The assurance step now matches an RSL claim by its claim_id (assurance.rules.assess_case claim_ref). Only the service identity or an operator creates/sends such a claim (submissions.domain.check_create, RSL_INTAKE_TRANSITIONS; test_domain.py); a taxpayer cannot edit it or forge one (bench test_only_the_intake_records_and_sends_an_rsl_claim).

Claim lines and RSL-held documents are stored as IDs and hashes in source_refs (lines: line_id and kind; documents: document_id, line_id, kind, held_by RSL); no amounts, invoice numbers or files are copied (test_rules: test_a_claim_becomes_one_reference...; bench test_rsl_held_documents_are_references_and_nothing_is_copied: no Vati Evidence for the case, evidence_ids empty). The checks read lines from RSL when they run. RSL unavailable: bench test_rsl_not_answering_is_reported_as_unavailable_never_as_no_claims (online_refunds unavailable -> run and taxpayer status unavailable, no submissions; source not configured -> unavailable with reason).
